notes.title: 1.4 More zoom and bug fixes
notes.content:
Hello again! Time for another update.

This update was supposed to be a small bugfix patch to fix a few bugs before going back to finish up Moose Diver. But I couldn't keep myself from at least including one more thing, so I took a few days to implement some big performance improvements for the map rendering to allow for much more zoom. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640025/c2a44fe329fc39c245bcfe99835ff6f8c2f51ffe.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640025/1de790ab16fd64d0c56b37ee0b6cddfc1c32555b.png[/img]

The first screenshot show shows the previous max zoom and the second screenshot shows the new max zoom. 

This new max zoom limit might be a bit too ambitious for some lower end systems, but I decided to keep it there to not limit the systems that can handle it fine. And it works at a playable framerate on my 10 year old mid tier gaming laptop, so it should probably be fine for most people. And if it too heavy on the new max zoom, the lower zoom levels should run much faster now than before anyways, so win-win. 

The moose group areas are now also visible and can be adjusted in the map view.

Now the plan is to go back to work on Moose Diver to make that game ready for release, should hopefully not take too long since it is a much smaller game than Moose Miners. Then after that I will start working on final content update I was talking about in the previous update post. It will likely be split into two updates though. I will also run a beta for that as soon as I have something that is ready enough to be worthwhile for external testing. That will be ran through the discord server, so if you would be interested in that come join that and keep an eye out for a an beta announcement: https://discord.com/invite/YVNsTCRbC2 

Full patch notes below:

Additions/Improvements
[list]
[*] Improved map render performance
[*] Increased zoom level from camera y-position 1500 to camera y-position 5000
[*] Added moose group areas to map rendering
[*] The game now saves the window position and what monitor it was last on when in windowed mode, and it will now start on the same screen and position it was when it exited
[/list]

Bug fixes
[list]
[*] Fixed an extra empty moose cart appearing for certain moose carry capacity upgrades
[*] Fixed the last capacity upgrade sometimes being reset when save game is reloaded
[*] Fixed buttons being disabled after right clicking when holding a control group flag
[*] Fixed a bug causing the cost calculations for moose upgrades to be slower than neccessary in some cases
[*] Fixed a possible cause for some moose upgrades upgrading past the current money causing negative money sometimes
[*] Loading a save with negative money now resets the money to 0
[*] Made the game turn off Nvidia driver setting "Threaded Optimization". This seems to have a driver bug causing the infamous yellow screen issue on some Nvidia gpus. It also seemed to not have a noticable affect on the performance.
[*] Added check on load for any moose upgrade related achievements that should be unlocked that have not been unlocked
[*] Fixed a bug that could cause some save slots to end up in a state where they would not save anymore
[*] Fixed a bug causing minecarts to lose resources when loading a saved game when carrying above a certain amount
[*] Fixed a crash issue that could happen when a lot of moose tried to unload to the same minecarts
[*] Fixed some storage points moving gems and sticks at double speed
[*] Fixed a crash when using -lowGraphics on a GPU that doesn't support OpenGL 4.5
[/list]

notes.title: 1.3 Compressors and more upgrade tiers
notes.content:
Hello everyone! It's update time!

The focus for this update is new upgrades and upgrade tiers to solve base bottlenecks in the late game. 

It comes with a new upgrade for the grinders, compressors. They can be added on the gem side and on the tree side and will compress gems or logs so more can fit on the grinder slopes. The compressed gems and logs then gets uncompressed after going through the grinders resulting in more throughput through the grinders. It starts with compressing 2 to 1 and next upgrade 3 to 1 and then 4 to 1 and so on. 

Then there are some new tiers for the storage box upgrades, the storage minecart, the balance minecart, and crafters. 

The full list of changes and fixes is listed below. Have fun playing and if you encounter any bugs or have any ideas for future updates come join the Discord server: https://discord.com/invite/YVNsTCRbC2 There are a channel for bug reports and another one for feature request there.

[*] Reduced the number of logs/gems rendered when unloading from sci-fi moose carts to increase performance
[*] New upgrade compressors
[*] 5 new storage boxes tiers for gems, sticks and wands
[*] 2 new storage minecart tiers
[*] 2 new balance minecart tiers
[*] Balance minecart now takes its max speed into account when selecting target areas
[*] 4 new crafter tiers
[/list]

Balance changes
[list]
[*] Lowered the unlock cost of storage minecart tier 4
[*] Increased the transfer rate for minecarts to buffer chests
[*] Lowered the unlock cost of storage boxes tier 2 - 4
[*] Lowered the cost scaling of the crafts per tick upgrade
[*] Lowered the cost scaling of moose saw damage upgrade
[*] Lowered the cost scaling of moose capacity upgrade
[/list]

Bug fixes

[*] Fixed Jet engine upgrade showing wrong tooltip when not being enabled sometimes
[*] Fixed gems or trees being rendered on top of the base sometimes when pressing move camera to storage/balance minecart button
[*] Fixed cost for moose upgrades being shown as 0 sometimes when upgrade amount was set to max
[*] Fixed saves not being loaded in some rare occasions
[*] Fixed mine buffer chests not rendering at the correct position in map mode when just bought new rail
[*] Fixed wands not being rendered in map mode
[*] Fixed price reductions costs for tier 40-49 being more expensive than intended
[*] Fixed last merged chest upgrade costing 0
[*] Fixed some merged chest upgrades having lower costs than intended
[*] Fixed a bug causing moose to not move sometimes when their target position were far away
[*] Fixed a crash issue on some older cpus
[*] Fixed pause menu opening while pressing Esc to close advanced gameplay control menu
[*] Fixed crafts per tick upgrade not always prioritising the lowest upgraded crafters
[*] Fixed costs for moose upgrades displaying as negative when reaching high values
[*] Fixed some buttons visually reacting to clicks through an overlay
[*] Fixed Rail length upgrade cost being wrong with rail build mode setting set to basic and upgrade amount set to 1, 10, 100 or 1k 
[*] Fixed add moose cost not being calculated properly on max amount with price reducitons unlocked

notes.title: 1.2 New languages and a map
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I hope you all liked the New Depths update. Today it is time for another update. While it is not a very big update compared to the previous one at least some people might be excited to be able to play the game in their own language as the main addition in this one is support to some more languages than English. You can see the full list of new supported languages in the patch notes below.

Translating a game can be quite a difficult task to get right and it is not always easy to convey the context for the texts to the translators, so if you find anything that feels off in the translation of a particular language, let me know either in the Discord server or on the Steam forums, and I will have it updated the next time I send stuff for translation. 

I know that for players already playing the game fine in English new language support is not very exciting. So I wanted to have at least some new thing in the game in this update. So here is a much requested feature, a map feature to allow zooming out further. 

Being able to zoom out more has been one of the most requested features since the release of the game. And I totally get it, when the base gets large you want to see more of it at the same time. Both to get a better overview of it and to be able to manage it on a larger scale. The issue with it has been that the game is already running close to the limit of most typical GPUs at the current max zoom level on large bases due to rendering a lot of things. And while there is room for improvement performance wise in the rendering it would likely take quite a lot of time for not as much more zoom. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640025/4be9891228b4539d1424eb5f7ab2e97012fc02eb.png[/img]

So the solution, which also has been suggested by several people, is a 2d map. If you have played Factorio it will fell familiar as it works very similar to its map view. Now if you zoom out further than the previous limit the game will switch to a 2d map view of the base. The game can still be played normally in this view, you can select things and upgrade them just as you can in the normal 3d view. It is just a much simpler representation of the base. 

Now I did not have time to make the map view as optimized as I would have wanted in time for this update, so it there is a zoom limit for it as well so it wont go into too low fps when zoomed out. But I figured it is much more zoom than before so it was worth including this version in the update. My plan is to increase the zoom limit of the map quite a lot in a future update after I've done some more optimizations of it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640025/49de2053394725f5adc4a6c4bf21e9fc09fc7db7.png[/img]

Speaking of plans for future updates, now with this translation update done, the next thing I will start working on is new upgrades for the grinders and the storage minecart which are currently causing big bottlenecks in late game bases. 

Features/Additions/Improvements
[list]
[*] Increased max zoom out, with new 2d rendering when zooming out further than previous max
[*] Added support for the following languages:  German, Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Simplified Chinese
[*] Various UI changes to support the new languages
[/list]

notes.title: Moose Miners New Depths Update!
notes.content:
Finally it is time for another update! I'm sorry it took so long. I planned to get this out quite a bit sooner, but due to some personal health issues I have only been able to work half-time and with reduced capacity the last few months. I hope you understand. 

First of all I want to thank the ones that helped test the new update on the beta branch. If you want to try out any future updates before they are done, it is all handled on the Discord so feel free to join: [url=https://discord.com/invite/YVNsTCRbC2]https://discord.com/invite/YVNsTCRbC2[/url]

Now let's get to the new things in the update!

If you are not a fan of reading you can checkout the new trailer for the update here: 
[previewyoutube=BSDDttqiuV8;full][/previewyoutube]

As the name of the update "New Depths" suggests the main thing is that the depth limit has been increased from the previous 4800 (gems/trees) to 57600. The gems and trees past the previous limit now has an additional magic layer causing them to hold even more gems and logs for mining. 

However, the ones of you that have gotten to the current limit knows that just increasing the depth and the available gems and logs won't work that well since the mining times at those depths with the current upgrade limits would be really slow and not very interesting. So there are a bunch of new upgrade tiers for things and a few completely new things as well to help with that.

I will summarise the new stuff here, but all the new things will be in the patch notes at the end of the post. 

Let's start with some moose upgrades, the game is called Moose Miners after all. The one I'm most excited about is the side saw upgrade, maybe because it looks both cool and ridiculous at the same time.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640025/33bbda0cede72fc8f0715377cd41ceafcaa0689e.png[/img] 
Side saws works just as expected, the moose can mine more than one gem or tree at the same time. A good way to get more out of each moose, just remember to upgrade the capacity of the moose so they can keep up with the increased amount of gems or logs. 

Speaking of capacity there are many new upgrade tiers for the "Moose cart" upgrade. Upgrading past the previous max will now upgrade the carts to high tech carts that can compact the gems and logs to hold much higher quantities. So now the moose can reach really high capacity levels without your GPU catching fire due to rendering millions of gems at once. 

There is also new tiers for the saw upgrade as well as for the speed upgrade. The drinking hats could only make the moose run so fast so I had to find some new things to make them go quicker. The first one is roller skates, which you can see if look closely in the image above. The moose can really high speeds with those, but to push it further some external force was needed. So I just strapped some really large jet engines on their backs. This should get them to a maximum of 75 m/s which is quite fast for a moose.

Besides the moose there are also some new things for the minecarts. Both the vertical minecarts and the storage and balance minecarts have gotten new tiers to upgrade to. A completely new thing however, is the buffer chests. They come in two versions base buffer chests and mine buffer chests and are an upgrade to the railway. The base buffer chests are placed between the grinder slopes and the rail and the mine buffer chests are at the end of the railway. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640025/9bd3bb71de2d4a0552763dbf4e0190468a0135ad.png[/img]

As the name suggests these chests are used a buffer. The moose can unload to buffer chests whether the minecarts are there or not and the minecarts unloads to the base buffer chests, which most often is quicker than waiting for the grinders to process the gems. All in all the buffer chests makes the usage of minecarts more efficient since they can often just move between the mine and the base with little wait time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640025/d3750f1b778d66af95a7d02bb5e34e7747c197bb.png[/img]

There is also a merged chest upgrade for the base buffer chests that merges chests that are next to each other. This allows one minecart to unload to a wide chest which then can unload to more than one grinder.

There are a few other new upgrades as well, storage boxes that increases how much can be stored in a storage tile, new crafter (wizard moose) tiers allowing for faster wand crafting. And two new upgrade categories, Price reductions and Bonuses. The price reduction upgrades reduces the cost of a specific type upgrades by a percentage, for example the moose upgrades. So you can invest money into making the moose cheaper to buy and upgrade. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640025/f186055d7aeaf5e8cc02ce3afbc0b23615c0dab6.png[/img]

The bonuses comes in two types, production and luck. Production increases the output of the upgraded entity type by a percentage. For example a production bonus of 50% for miners gives an extra gem for every 2nd gem mined. Or a production bonus of 100% for grinders would give two sticks for each log processed or 2 gem dusts for each gem processed. It basically outputs more resources than what was put in allowing for some really nice boosts in the factory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640025/e62b79130ac3449f38240d168f409a57d0a38f67.png[/img]

Luck gives a chance for a resource to be upgraded to the next tier. If you have 25% logger luck and a moose is cutting the pink trees there is a 25% chance it gets a blue log instead. The chance is reduced when going to the gold, diamond or black tier. 

There are also a bunch of balance changes. You can see them all in the detailed patch notes, but I want to bring up a few extra important ones here. in this update I have increased the cost scaling of moose and grinders by quite a lot. I felt that you ended up with the maximum number of moose and maximum width of the base way too quickly before you had the chance to appreciate the balancing of everything else. So the best strategy was pretty much just buying more moose and going wide. 

Due to this rebalance and some infinite gems/trees glitches causing a lot more money than intended for some saves there will be an option when loading an existing save on the new update (in case you have gotten far enough for these things to matter). There you will be able to choose between keeping your save as it is, but then not being included on the leaderboard with this save. Or rebalance the save which will set you in probably a rather high negative amount of money. Selling moose and grinders is the way to get back to positive and there is an option to just sell grinders and moose automatically until you are in the clear again. 

I have also worked quite a lot on performance improvements to make it work well with the new things and a lot of bugs have been fixed. 

If you have read this far I just want to thank you for the support on the game, I hope you will enjoy the update and if you have not already please consider leaving an honest review of the game.

notes.title: 1.0.7 The balance minecart update
notes.content:
Hello everyone! The time has come for another update to the best game featuring mining moose on Steam!

Let's start with the main addition in this update, the balance minecart. A way to move around resources to fix imbalances between the amount of sticks and gems in the storage for wand crafting has been requested by a lot of you in different forms, but the idea of having minecarts redistribute sticks I first saw as a suggestion in the Lingon Studios Discord server.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640025/0ab2a03994a67520846b8e8806acf6378629034e.png[/img]

The balance minecart is a train of minecarts that will pickup sticks from crafter areas that have a surplus of sticks and deliver them to crafter areas that have a surplus of gems. It is unlocked as an upgrade in the upgrade window. When unlocked it can be upgraded under its own upgrade tab with the same type of upgrades as the storage minecart, i.e. speed, storage, cart count and load speed. Keep in mind that the balance minecart is not meant to be a complete solution for balancing gems and sticks for crafters. You will still need to somewhat plan where you place your moose on the gem side vs tree side.

This update also comes with some additional upgrades that helps solve bottlenecks you would run into when the base was fully upgraded. There is a new tier of the storage minecart to unlock to further increase its speed and storage capacity since the current one simply can't keep up for a fully upgraded base.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640025/11eb03a9baa6683bf44676d1fc19ae6d5b03ddc2.png[/img]

The next is the new upgrade, Grinder slopes, which upgrades how much the slopes just before the grinders can store. This also increases the unload speed of the minecarts as well as increases the maximum available grinder speed. With these new upgrades you should be able to mine and process the gems and trees in the last rows of the current depth limit at much better efficiency. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640025/3730cdce4dfbe1919e0ae4ca3205c890a99c791e.png[/img]

Please note that some tiers of these upgrades are in preparation for the next update which will increase the depth limit, so you will most likely not be able to max out all these upgrades with the currently available gems and trees. 

There are also a few quality of life things in this update. To begin with, the toggle fences buttons have been reworked a bit. Now instead of simply flipping the current state (fence on/ fence off) of the storage areas, they will set all the selected storage areas to the same state. The state they are set to depends on how many of the selected are currently on, but the first press of the button will sync them all up to the same state and then simply pressing it again will flip all of them to the other state if that was not the one you wanted. In addition to this, the buttons now also work with nothing selected and will then act as if all are selected. So now you can turn all the fences for the crafters on or off at the same time. This was a feature requested by many of you.

Two new navigation buttons have been added. One that moves the camera to the storage minecart and one that moves it to the balance minecart. The balance minecart button is unlocked after the balance minecart upgrade has been unlocked. 

Then there are also a bunch of bug fixes, you'll find the full list of changes at the bottom of this post.

I hope you all enjoy the update and thanks for all the bug reports and suggestions you are writing on both the Steam discussion forums and on the Discord server. Even though I am not replying to all posts I am reading everything you write on the Steam discussion forums and in the moose-miners-bug-reports and moose-miners-suggestions channels on Discord. I just don't have time to reply to most things unless I need some additional information to figure out a bug or an issue. That's the life of a solo dev, so much more you want to do than there is time in a day.

[*] Added a new upgrade "Grinder slopes". Upgrades the capacity of the slopes before the grinders increasing the unload speed of minecarts and increasing the maximum grinder speed upgrade
[*] Added a new upgrade "Balance minecart". A minecart that will transport sticks from crafter stations that have a surplus of sticks to crafter stations that have a surplus of gems

notes.title: 1.0.6 Sell button, moose selector and more!
notes.content:
Time for a quality of life update! The main things in this update is the sell button that let's you sell stuff and a moose selector that allows for some more advanced selection of the moose. There are a few other smaller additions included that have been requested by you and also some bug fixes so let's go through all the changes in this update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640025/c4945a6b329919f9bb8a139149b4cb5236366096.png[/img]

I'll start with the sell button which is a feature that has been requested a lot. The request for a sell button has often been coupled with a request for an undo option as well to undo accidental purchases of many grinders for example. I decided to focus on the sell button only in this update since I think it will solve the issue for most people and it is much quicker to implement than a full undo system. Implementing an undo feature would be a much more involved thing taking longer time which would mean other planned nice features and new content would have to wait or be discarded to make so let's start with this sell button and see if that can be enough for most cases. 

To sell things you first select what you want to sell, for example some moose or some rail. Then the sell button will show in its tooltip how much you will get by selling it. You get back half the price of upgrades on the thing you are selling and the full price of the actual thing. So for example when selling moose, any upgrades would be refunded by half their cost and the cost of buying the moose will be refunded in full.

To reduce the accidental buys a bit I have added a confirmation dialog when trying to buy a lot of grinders, since the grinders seem to be the most common case of accidental buying. Please let me know if you buy something else in large numbers that are tedious to sell afterwards to undo, that would benefit of being protected by the new dialog. The dialog can be disabled completely in settings. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640025/40e3066725a36f61ee7e8b7cfa9dbdd46522d904.png[/img]

The next exciting new feature is the moose selector. You find it in the new advanced gameplay control menu, where it is currently the only thing. You expect some more things to appear in that menu in the future. 

In there, you can filter which moose you want to select by whether they are on the gem side or on the tree side, if they are in a group or not or a certain group. As well as filter how many you want to select by picking a maximum number to select and a percentage of the moose that fit the filter to select. 

As a part of this I renamed the miners to moose when talked about in the general sense, and then they are called miners on the gem side and loggers on the tree side. You can now also see how many are on each side in the info panel that shows your company value and mining depth. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640025/c4f468bccf10a4ea393cb8a5ec4b8aa895a9e766.png[/img]

Another thing added in this update that has been requested a lot is the ability to toggle crafters on or off. Or more specifically, I have added a fence that indicates that the gems and trees will not be picked up by the storage minecart when a crafter has been added on a tile. This fence can be toggled on or off, and when off the storage minecart will pickup gems or trees from that tile. The crafter will still be able to work when the fence is off if there are both gems and trees available. To unlock the toggling of fences you need to have the resource spillage upgrade unlocked.

Due to popular requests two new amounts for the upgrade amount selector has been added, 100 and 1000. So now you don't have to click a hundred times when you want to buy exactly 1000 moose. 

I also made it so if you hold down shift with nothing selected the selection rectangle will prioritize moose over everything else if there are any moose in the rectangle. The shift button has been a hidden way of achieving sort of this behaviour already since it makes a selection additive, meaning if you have moose selected and hold down shift it will select additional moose instead of selecting something else. But now you don't have to find a moose to select first, just hold down shift and you will select only moose even if they are hiding under rail.

That was the main new additions in this update, there are a few other improvements and a bunch of bug fixes that you can read about in the full patch notes below. Thank you everyone that has come with suggestions for improvements for the game, and to everyone that has helped with bug fixes by sending me your save files.

Hope you'll like this update, I'll go start on the next one. The plan for the next larger update is to add an additional minecart or train in the base that moves sticks around to make it easier to balance the sticks and gems for wand crafting.

[*] Added a sell button
[*] Right click now deselects the current selection
[*] Info box when nothing is selected now shows miner count and logger count, i.e. how many moose are on the gem side and how many moose are on the tree side
[*] Miner(s) has been replaced with Moose in the UI text when it is refering to both miners and loggers. If I have missed to change it anywhere please let me know.
[*] Increased moose vision range when looking for gems/trees or unload points
[*] Added fences to indicate that the storage minecart won't pickup gems or trees from a tile after a crafter has been added
[*] Toggle fences upgrade now also allows toggling the new fences on or off to allow the storage minecart to pickup gems or trees from tiles with crafters
[*] Added 100, and 1000 to upgrade amount
[*] Moose will be prioritised on selection if holding down shift with nothing selected
[/list]

Bug fixes

notes.title: Update 1.0.1 Performance and stability improvements
notes.content:
Hi! Time for an update to the game. This update is all about performance and stability since that is what was needed the most for the game right now. Wands and sticks are now bundled up into boxes when they get over certain numbers in the storage. This will greatly help with the GPU performance since rendering hundreds of thousands wands and sticks became quite the challenge for even the beefiest of GPUs. I also fixed a few bottlenecked in the multi-threading system for the simulation that made large bases go into very low ticks per second. So the very large bases should see a large performance improvement for multi-core CPUs. 

With these two areas of performance improvements I am currently getting at least 60 fps in most areas in a base that is upgraded to the max on the width and have rails on all lanes with my Ryzen 5800x and GTX 1080 TI. Just to give you something to compare to. This will not be last performance improvements for the game, it was just the low hanging fruit for now and should hopefully be enough for the time being so I can focus on some QOL features and after that some new content. But I will probably sprinkle some more performance improvements in upcoming. The game will always be quite cpu intensive for large bases though, and scales quite well with core count. So a recent cpu with 8 cores or more is recommended for a large base. I have added a note under system requirements on the store page to reflect this. If you don't have an as powerful cpu you might want to focus more on depth than width in your base as that will be much less taxing on the cpu.

You can see the full patch notes of today's patch at the bottom of the post.

Next week I am planning on starting working on selling stuff, since that is probably the most requested feature and I will probably look into some other smaller QOL features as well that has been requested.

notes.title: Demo update 0.4 Control groups and leaderboards
notes.content:
Hi, time for a little bit larger update to the demo. I have recently finished the control group feature of the game and thought there was no good reason to not include that in the demo as it could give you a few more ways of playing the game while you wait for the full version. In addition I thought I might as well add leaderboards for speed running since I wanted to have some sort of leaderboard for the full game as well. So this update also include two leaderboards for those who want to maximize efficiency and compete.

There are also a few bug fixes and some tweaks to a few of the upgrades costs in the game that you can read about in the full patch notes below. But first I'll explain the control groups and new leaderboards in more detail.

Starting with the control groups. The control groups allows you to group moose together by selecting them and pressing the create control group button. Then you get a button at the bottom left of the screen that when pressed selects all the moose in that group. This can be useful if you have certain moose you want to upgrade separately from the rest of them. In addition each control group have a flag that you can place in the world. When placed the flag will show an area that any moose in the control group will mine inside. The area can be resized as well. So if there are some rare gems you really want to get to quickly you can set a control group flag for that area and the moose will work their way deeper into that specific area. 

Then we have leaderboards. I have added two leaderboards that will be exclusive for the demo due to their nature. The first one is for mining to the north demo wall in the shortest time. So as soon as you mine the last gem before the wall in a column the time will be recorded and uploaded to the leaderboard. If you have one of the top 100 best times then you will appear in the leaderboard that can be reached from the main menu. The second leaderboard is for clearing the full demo area in the shortest time. So get your strategies ready and optimize your starting build orders to claim the top spots in the leaderboard. To keep track of your current time there is a clock button at the top right of the screen that you can press to see the current time of your save.

An extra tip for the ones reading all the text in this update post: Each save of the game has a different seed, so you can reset the game from the main menu until you get a seed that looks good, for example that has a good amount of gold ores close enough for early mining.

I'm glad so many have already tried the demo and a lot of you seem to like it. Quite a few of you have played enough to mine out the whole demo map already!
This is a small update fixing a few bugs and adding some quality of life improvements to the demo. It also includes a reset button in the main menu settings menu so you easier can restart if you want to play again with a different strategy

[h1]Features/Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added a reset button in main menu settings menu
[*] Rail will now be built from all columns when nothing is selected instead of just the columns that has rail built already. Added an option in settings to make it work like before
[*] Added hover tooltips for the upgrade category buttons
[*] Upgrade buttons now show "max" when an upgrade has been maxed out
[*] Added gem health in the gem info boxes
[*] Miners will now wait for minecarts that are close to be ready to load gems
[/list] 

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed the close button not working on some screen sizes
[*] Fixed a bug causing minecarts position to change when adding new minecarts
[/list]
